Plan the gathering. Leave out the guesswork.

The details to agree before choosing a menu and confirming your event.

How do I check availability?

Send your preferred date, venue or area, and guest estimate through the enquiry form. The team will confirm whether the date and service can be arranged.

Can the menu be changed?

Yes, the menu collections are a starting point. Share the dishes you like and any changes you have in mind so ingredients, service style, and pricing can be discussed together.

How should I share allergy requirements?

List each allergy and dietary requirement in your enquiry. The team will discuss ingredients and preparation before you decide. Do not assume that a menu is free from a particular allergen.

What does the venue need to provide?

Tell us about kitchen facilities, electricity, water, access, and the dining area. Agree equipment, tableware, furniture, and service responsibilities as part of your proposal.

What if the guest count changes?

Contact the team as soon as your estimate changes. The proposal will set out when the final guest count is needed and how later changes are handled.

When is the event confirmed?

The team will prepare a proposal with the menu, date, service arrangements, and payment terms. Your event is confirmed once those arrangements are agreed directly with you.

Have your event details ready?

Start with the date, guest estimate, and venue. Add the menu or service style you are considering.
